notes: Rules classify upstream Canvas WPT areas that are outside the current implementation.
Official smoke tests live in tests/wpt/canvas-smoke-tests.txt and are executed by npm run test:wpt.

rules.reason: Depends on HTMLCanvasElement attributes, parser reflection, layout, fallback content, or DOM host behavior outside createCanvas().
Depends on OffscreenCanvas and worker host behavior.
Depends on HTML media/image loading host behavior.
Depends on DOM element capture, layout, paint invalidation, hit testing, privacy tainting, or browser top-layer behavior outside createCanvas().
Depends on browser ImageBitmap, Blob/image/video decoding, transfer, worker, or ImageBitmapRenderingContext host behavior.
Depends on browser canvas context attributes such as alpha and getContextAttributes() host behavior outside the current createCanvas() facade.
Depends on HTMLImageElement, SVG/image decoding, cross-origin tainting, Blob/ImageBitmap sources, or image-orientation host behavior.
Depends on browser HDR metadata/image decoding and global HDR headroom host behavior.
Depends on browser CSS/layout integration for canvas elements.
Depends on browser DOM sibling/layout crash coverage outside createCanvas().
Depends on browser color/input plumbing outside the current Canvas 2D package surface.
Depends on DOM flat-tree and font/layout integration outside createCanvas().
Depends on browser historical global interface exposure beyond this package's createCanvas() facade.
Depends on browser DOM/font/layout crash behavior outside deterministic text metrics fallback.
Path construction and simple fill/stroke behavior have smoke coverage; broader pixel-accurate path rendering, clipping, and hit testing remain incomplete.
Path2D is available for supported path commands; clipping, hit testing, and many exact path rendering cases remain incomplete.

Line state, cap rendering, selected join/miter rendering, invalid stroke-style no-op behavior, and basic stroke width behavior have smoke coverage; remaining tests require exact join, miter, cross-line, and transformed stroke raster fidelity.

Layer smoke coverage includes call validation, saved-state boundaries, rendering-state reset/restore, reset discarding active layers, offscreen compositing, readback/source rejection, basic transforms, and parent-transform application for layer drop-shadow filters; remaining layer tests require browser-exact filter, clipping, shadow, nesting, and compositing reference fidelity.

Text style state, basic font/spacing parsing, and empty-string measureText() have smoke coverage; remaining text WPTs require fillText(), broader strokeText(), font loading, shaping, or browser-exact text metrics.
Text drawing and text metrics are not implemented yet.
drawImage() supports canvas sources with unit coverage; broader WPTs require ImageBitmap, HTMLImageElement, decoded resources, and additional CanvasImageSource host behavior.
Core globalAlpha/globalCompositeOperation fillRect coverage exists; remaining tests need drawImage(), clipping, broader pattern/shadow/filter interactions, and pixel-accurate advanced blend modes.
Shadow state and simple rendering have smoke coverage; blurred shadows, image/pattern shadows, clipping, transforms, and exact pixel fidelity remain incomplete.

Filter state, opacity() unit rendering, CanvasFilter object identity/validation, colorMatrix rendering, componentTransfer rendering, gaussianBlur/dropShadow validation/defaults, and layer filter option validation have smoke coverage; remaining filter tests require browser-exact gaussianBlur/dropShadow visual reftest fidelity.

Named/HTML4, hex, legacy rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla(), transparent, CSSRGB/CSSHSL, invalid color retention, gradient object behavior, and canvas-backed pattern/repetition validation have smoke/unit coverage; modern relative/color-mix CSS parsing, exact gradient fidelity, image-backed patterns, and pattern transforms remain incomplete.

getImageData(), createImageData(), ImageData object behavior, and putImageData() have broad smoke/unit coverage for sRGB unorm8 data; ImageBitmap round-trips, wide-gamut color spaces, and float16 pixel data remain incomplete.
The full upstream rectangle drawing directory is smoke-gated; remaining classification is kept for future upstream additions that may depend on filters, broader shadows, or exact raster edge cases.
reset() bitmap clearing and drawing-state reset behavior have smoke coverage; remaining reset rendering reference tests depend on broader text, shadow, compositing, and pixel-fidelity coverage.
save()/restore() cover implemented drawing state including styles, shadows, filters, line, text, and transforms; remaining state areas are incomplete.

imageSmoothingEnabled and imageSmoothingQuality state are implemented with nearest/bilinear drawImage sampling; manual visual image-smoothing WPT coverage and quality-specific filtering remain incomplete.
Depends on broader filter, shadow, COLR glyph, and compositing pixel fidelity beyond current smoke coverage.
Depends on drawFocusIfNeeded() or path rendering edge cases not implemented in the current Canvas 2D surface.
Depends on browser font loading, MathML/disconnected-tree font behavior, and exact text rendering.
Depends on currentColor rendering, exact conic gradient fidelity, image/video patterns, or cross-origin tainting behavior.
Depends on full CSS/SVG filter rendering, CanvasFilter objects, visited-color tainting, or browser-exact filter fidelity.
Depends on visual image smoothing quality/reference fidelity beyond current nearest/bilinear drawImage sampling.
Depends on browser behavior for unclosed canvas layers at presentation time.
Depends on exact line dash/line rendering reference fidelity beyond current unit and smoke coverage.
Depends on system colors or browser-exact Gaussian shadow blur fidelity.
Depends on DOM direction/language inheritance, font stretch rendering, and browser-exact text shaping/layout.
Depends on browser canvas element sizing behavior beyond current save/restore state smoke coverage.
Depends on manual/reference transformation rendering fidelity beyond current automated transform smoke coverage.
Canvas color space and color type options are not implemented yet.
Depends on display-p3 canvas, ImageBitmap, image/video decoding, and color-managed ImageData fidelity.
Depends on broader ImageData constructor/color settings behavior than the current sRGB unorm8 smoke coverage.
Canvas color type options are not implemented yet.
